battle.verdict: Pictory is the overall winner for crafting superior marketing ads with ease. InVideo still offers more granular editing control for experienced users, but it takes longer.

narration.text: Which AI actually creates more engaging marketing ads?

First, ad quality! Pictory excels at transforming scripts into relevant video ads, choosing visuals that truly hit home. InVideo, however, often selects generic stock footage, resulting in less impactful ads. Pictory takes this round easily!

Next, ease of use. Pictory's interface is incredibly intuitive, streamlining the ad creation process. InVideo can feel a bit clunky, with a steeper learning curve that slows things down. Another win for Pictory here!
Pictory is our clear champion, creating better marketing ads with greater ease. InVideo still offers more detailed editing options, but it requires more time. Which one would you pick?
